app.name: us-stream
app.description: Rooms for video, audio and screen sharing — with chat, a shared whiteboard and breakout rooms.

landing.headline: A meeting room you actually own.
landing.subhead: Video and audio, screen sharing, chat, a shared whiteboard and breakout rooms. Send the link and people join without an account.

features.videoBody: Active speaker highlighting, grid and presentation layouts, device selection and a connection quality readout.
features.screenBody: Share a tab with its audio, switch to presentation mode, pin whoever you want to watch.
features.chatBody: Live messaging, emoji reactions, raised hands and a speaking queue.
features.boardBody: A whiteboard that stays with the room, and shared notes everyone writes in at once.
features.breakoutBody: Split people into sub-rooms, give them a timer, and pull everyone back with one click.
features.pollBody: Live poll results, questions the room can upvote, and an answered marker.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to get back to your rooms.
auth.signUpSubtitle: An account is all you need to open persistent rooms and keep their history.
auth.name: Name
auth.guestNotice: You do not need an account to join a meeting — the invite link is enough.

dashboard.title: My rooms
dashboard.subtitle: Your persistent rooms and past meetings.
dashboard.emptyBody: Open a persistent room and its link stays the same — meet at the same address whenever you like.
